data.name: Aneeza
data.gender_notes: Aneeza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A graceful and elegant girl, who is gentle, kind and sweet. The name Aneeza carries the meaning “Gracious, gentle, sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aneeza usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, gentle, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a girl who is a symbol of Allah's grace and mercy.
data.etymology: Aneeza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, gentle, sweet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aneeza total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عنيزة

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عنيزة مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع ن ز) و يعني الفتاة التي تتمتع بالحنان و اللطف و الخفة في حركاتها و معاملاتها. و قد ورد هذا الاسم في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: عنیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: عنیزہ یعنی مخلص، پیاری، نرم و ملائم لڑکی

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aneeza" in Islamic culture represents the qualities of grace, elegance, gentleness, kindness, and sweetness in a girl. It is a beautiful and expressive name that reflects the nurturing and feminine aspects of Arabic and Islamic cultures. The name "Aneeza" evokes images of a young girl who is well-respected and admired for her graceful and affectionate demeanor.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aneeza" carries the significance of a beautiful soul, one who embodies the essence of kindness, gentleness, and sweetness. It reflects the belief that every human being is a reflection of the divine and that we should strive to live in accordance with God's law of love and compassion. The name "Aneeza" serves as a reminder that we should treat all beings with kindness and respect, and that our actions and words should reflect the grace and elegance found in the natural world around us. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "A gentle word is the weapon of the wise and the powerful equipment of the weak" (Bukhari and Muslim). In this way, the name "Aneeza" can inspire us to be gentle, kind and compassionate individuals, who strive to use our words wisely and effectively, to build up, uplift, and encourage those around us.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aneeza serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gracious, gentle, sweet.
